name: macrolab
description: Korean and US macro data from macrolab.kr for your AI: 200+ monthly series since 2001 (rates, prices, growth, money, credit, FX, stocks, commodities, housing, sentiment, AI) plus daily twins, as files to pull or MCP tools, with a guide on reading them right.

interface.shortDescription: 한국·미국 거시경제 데이터를 AI로 직접 분석
interface.longDescription: Macro Lab (macrolab.kr) opens its public-licence macro data to its members' AI agents (membership is free; the server signs you in once through OAuth): 200+ monthly series for Korea, the US and global markets since 2001 (ECOS, FRED, R-ONE, 국토교통부 실거래가) plus public daily twins. Read-only MCP tools (search, series, daily, latest) and a skill that explains how to read each column, which unit and benchmark apply, and how to report a relationship without over-claiming. Models, forecasts and the track record of Macro Lab are not part of the data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Using Macro Lab data, chart Korean 3-year KTB yields against the US 2-year yield since 2020 and say what moved first.
